q: Your handler never fires in the background. A likely cause?
o: You sent a notification message, not a data message
why: The OS tray handles notification messages in the background.

q: Not deleting dead tokens leads to …
o: slower sends and duplicate or wasted work
why: Clean them when UNREGISTERED comes back.

q: A service-account key can safely be committed to a private repo.
why: Keep it out of git; a leaked key lets anyone send pushes as you.

q: A user on some phone brands never gets your push. The likely reason?
o: An aggressive battery manager delays or drops it
FCM is blocked in their country
why: You cannot fix this server-side; guide users to whitelist the app.
